state.background: Phase 6 batch B04 transfers exactly three Plan45 stable scenarios to Browser Mode: p45-a-parity-section-cpi-major, p45-a-parity-section-earnings, and p45-a-parity-section-new-graph. It adds the permanent fail-on-contract Browser Mode spec/config and a focused production-route command. Only the matching three source CONTRACT entries were removed from Playwright after the focused replacement passed and independent source-boundary review. Residual and stacked monthly parity scenarios remain Playwright-owned. The current ledger is A=123/E=123/M=100; 10 of 33 eligible Phase 6 scenarios are accepted and 23 remain Playwright-owned. Phase 6 remains in progress. Two focus-management fixtureTest deletions in tests/e2e/accessibility.e2e.spec.ts have unknown provenance, are outside B01-B04, and are excluded from M.
acceptanceCriteria: All three B04 stable IDs preserve their source assertion boundaries in a permanent fail-on-contract Browser Mode suite.

The suite asserts complete chart/table/CSV parity for each source section across all rows, including typed metadata, row floor greater than two, January 2025, ordered series, CRLF CSV, INTERNAL-series exclusion, and absence of a typedKey descriptor.
Only the source CONTRACT entries corresponding to these three IDs were removed; residual and stacked monthly parity scenarios remain represented in Playwright.
The focused production Browser Mode command is wired into the route runner and default CI and passes before B04 is counted as a full cutover.
The Phase 6 plan and canonical inventory consistently record A=123, E=123, M=100, 10 accepted eligible scenarios, and 23 remaining.

Focused Browser Mode and residual E2E evidence plus independent source-boundary review support this transfer; unknown-provenance focus-management deletions are disclosed and excluded from B04 accounting.

state.outputRequirement: Choose exactly one criterion for this implementation checkpoint. Provide effective verdict, decision summary and full choice distribution, evidence tied to B04 IDs and artifact paths, any required correction with exact location, and remaining uncertainty. Do not promote partial ownership or feasibility evidence to a full migration. If the initial choice is not valid_as_defined, follow exactly one required case-specific clarification and preserve the initial result; do not turn a non-pass into a pass.

implementation.instructions: Evaluate whether B04 is a valid full cutover under the acceptance criteria and evidence. Select the single best matching criterion.

criteria.valid_as_defined: The supplied source-contract, cutover, ledger, and verification evidence supports accepting B04 as defined.
criteria.requirements_mismatch: A concrete conflict exists between requirements and implementation or recorded evidence; identify the requirement and requirement-only correction.
criteria.missing_prerequisites_info: Required prerequisite information is missing; identify exactly what is needed.
criteria.incomplete_implementation_info: Specific evidence needed to assess B04 is missing; identify the exact gap.
criteria.implementation_issue: A concrete implementation or reporting defect violates a criterion; name the location, evidence, and implementation-only correction.
criteria.scope_violation: The cutover exceeds or falls outside the agreed batch boundary; identify the boundary and adjustment.
criteria.other: A different concrete validity issue exists; state the finding, location, evidence, and next action.
criteria.indeterminate: The supplied context cannot support a decision; identify the missing context and resolving evidence.
